widget.prompt: This grid has 7 rows and 7 columns of unit squares. Count only the squares — not the edge around the grid.

commonCounts.feedback: That's 2 × (7 + 7) — the PERIMETER (the distance around the edge), not the area. Count every square filling the inside instead: 49.
That's just one row. Count all 7 rows: 49 in all.
